description: PR #15 / issue #14: automatic LiveView reconnect reauthenticates JWT but loses the selected conversation and rendered answer. Reproduced in Playwright after waiting for zaq:ready: the streamed Finished answer disappears and the mock host Saved answer history is not requested/rendered. WidgetLive.authenticate_on_mount calls Chat.open with only JWT and page id; integrated widget client replays parentContext only when explicitly set, not after a conversation_created receipt. Keep production fix separate from integration-test review; add a failing reconnect-history test with real mock host on resolution.
title: Restore selected conversation after authenticated LiveView reconnect
